figurative_meaning_en: symbol of worthless or fake honor
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুকে ছেঁদামালা পরিয়ে বিদায় করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He bid farewell to his friend with a coconut shell garland.
The award felt like a worthless garland of coconut shells.
note: Refers to a makeshift garland from coconut shells, common in rural Bengal for ironic or demeaning contexts.
